changelog: **Result counts are announced on every searchable list (WCAG 4.1.3, #2864):** the 29 screens and components with a search box (admin lists, the sidebar menu filter, notifications, jobs, the company overview, message search, canned replies, …) now speak "N results shown" / "No results" through `useFilterAnnouncement` + the new `resultCountMessage()` when a filter changes them. A VPAT `check:` fails if a new `type="search"` box ships without the hook. VPAT 4.1.3 now reads `Supports`.

en: Screen readers now hear how many results a search or filter leaves on every list.
tr: Ekran okuyucular artık her listede bir arama ya da filtrenin kaç sonuç bıraktığını duyuyor.
de: Screenreader hören jetzt in jeder Liste, wie viele Ergebnisse eine Suche oder ein Filter übrig lässt.
